description: Baseline capability for project windows. Minimal by design — permissions are added per feature, not up front. `dialog:allow-open` is what A1's file picker needs; `core:window:allow-set-title` lets the window name the container it holds; `dialog:allow-save` is where a pipeline, a style or a problem report is written to (C9, S6.8); `updater:default` and `process:allow-restart` are G4's check-and-install, which is one action in two halves; `opener:allow-open-url` is scoped to the repository — the alpha ribbon links to it and the problems panel opens an issue on it (S6.8) — and to nothing else.
